narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: Several roads were flooded in the central and southern portion of the city of Chesapeake, including Battlefield Boulevard and Benefit Road.
lsr: MULTIPLE REPORTS OF FLOODED ROADS IN THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN PORTION OF THE CITY OF CHESAPEAKE, INCLUDING BATTLEFIELD ROAD AND BENEFIT ROAD.
